title: Video: What You Must Know on the First Trading Day of the Year
text:
Here's everything you need to know before Monday's opening bell : 

BP ( BP ) said it will take a hit from recent changes to the tax code.  Natural gas prices soared as a cold snap grips the U.S. Apple ( AAPL ) said its battery-replacement discount will go in effect immediately.  Disney's ( DIS ) Star Wars: The Last Jedi passed Beauty and the Beast to become the top-grossing film of 2017.  Stock futures rose as the U.S. dollar slumped.
